name: SplitPane
description:
Two panes and the divider between them: a tree beside a table, a list above its details.
Drag the divider or use its keys; each pane keeps within its limits; the pane that gives
way hides on Enter, or behind a rail button in a narrow split. Remembered per window kind
inside a window body.
signature: ({ start, end, startLabel, endLabel, orientation, defaultSize, size: sizeProp, onSizeChange, startMin, startMax, endMin, endMax, collapse, collapseBelow, storageKey, name, className, style, ...rest }: SplitPaneProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: collapse
props.description: The pane that gives way: Enter on the divider hides it, and a narrow split hides it. Default "start".

props.name: collapseBelow
props.description: Below this length along the split, the pane that gives way hides behind a button. Default "40rem".

props.name: defaultSize
props.description: The first pane's size when none is remembered. Default "40%".

props.name: end
props.description: The second pane: the table, the details.

props.name: endLabel
props.description: Names the second pane's region, and its button when it is the one that gives way.

props.name: name
props.description: Tells several splits in one window kind apart in storage. Default "split".

props.name: onSizeChange
props.description: Called with the first pane's new size in px when a drag or a key press sets it.

props.name: orientation
props.description: `horizontal` (default): side by side. `vertical`: one above the other.

props.name: size
props.description: The first pane's size in px, controlled. Pair with `onSizeChange`.

props.name: start
props.description: The first pane: the tree, the list.

props.name: startLabel
props.description: Names the first pane: its region, the divider ("Resize Folders") and the button that shows it ("Show Folders").

props.name: startMax
props.description: The first pane's maximum. Default "100%" (only the second pane's minimum limits it).

props.name: storageKey
props.description:
Where the size is remembered (localStorage). Inside a window body it defaults to one key
per window kind (`glass-ux.split:window:<kind>:<name>`); elsewhere nothing is remembered
unless you pass one. null turns it off.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value when using the component without controlling its state.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
